user.title: Connect CloudPelizzon
user.description: To use this integration, register this installation with Fleet for free. Registration requires the Home Assistant owner (administrator) display name to identify the person responsible for the installation, together with the installation identifier and Home Assistant and CloudPelizzon versions. The administrator password, email and token are not sent. Registration does not start module trials or issue a commercial license.
